tagline: 美能达旁轴相机，1961 年发布
description: 美能达于1961年推出的旁轴相机。配备Minolta Rokkor PF 1:2/f=45mm (accepts 40,5 mm filters)。快门速度Optiper Citizen MLT with modern speeds (i.e. 1/60 instead of 1/50 etc.), 1 to 1/1000 sec.。使用Lever on the right side of the camera top, exposure counter in the camera bottom, fold-out rewind crank on the left side of the camera top, rewind release button on the bottom。

specs.快门: Optiper Citizen MLT with modern speeds (i.e. 1/60 instead of 1/50 etc.), 1 to 1/1000 sec.
